# Password Reset

A user can reset their password using a token delivered by email.

Requirements:
- A valid token and valid password should reset the password.
- An invalid token must be rejected.
- An expired token must be rejected.
- Passwords shorter than 8 characters must be rejected.
- The reset endpoint is POST /reset-password.

The system should return HTTP 200 for a successful reset and HTTP 400 for invalid requests.

Security note: the token should not be reusable.

scenarios.title: Valid reset
scenarios.description: Reset password with a valid token and valid password.

scenarios.title: Expired token
scenarios.description: Reject a password reset request when the token is expired.

scenarios.title: Invalid token
scenarios.description: Reject a malformed or unknown token.

scenarios.title: Password boundary
scenarios.description: Validate the minimum and maximum password length.

ambiguities: Token lifetime is not specified in the requirement.
The requirement does not state whether a reset token is single-use.

generated_tests.code:
import os
import requests

def test_valid_reset():
    base = os.getenv("QE_SUT_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8000")
    r = requests.post(base + "/reset-password", json={"token":"valid-token","password":"NewPassword123"})
    assert r.status_code == 200

import os
import requests

def test_expired_token():
    base = os.getenv("QE_SUT_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8000")
    r = requests.post(base + "/reset-password", json={"token":"expired-token","password":"NewPassword123"})
    assert r.status_code == 400

import os
import requests

def test_invalid_token():
    base = os.getenv("QE_SUT_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8000")
    r = requests.post(base + "/reset-password", json={"token":"not-a-real-token","password":"NewPassword123"})
    assert r.status_code == 400

import os
import requests

def test_password_too_short():
    base = os.getenv("QE_SUT_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8000")
    r = requests.post(base + "/reset-password", json={"token":"valid-token","password":"short"})
    assert r.status_code == 400
